ITEM 1 | Long thin pasta tubes (penne-like), pale golden-yellow with smooth glossy surface, lightly coated, lying across the right side of the plate, each piece about 5-6 cm long and 0.8 cm wide, holding shape | 45
ITEM 2 | Fresh leafy greens (spinach-like), dark green smooth-edged leaves, slightly wilted, a few whole leaves spread across the upper right and top center of the plate, each leaf about 4-5 cm across | 20
ITEM 3 | Crumbled brown granular mixture (looks like seasoned grain or lentil-like crumble), dark brown to tan, dry and crumbly with visible small granules, clustered in the lower center and right of the plate, roughly 4 cm by 3 cm patch, about 1 cm thick | 35
ITEM 4 | Cubed pale golden pieces (roasted potato-like chunks), edges lightly browned, matte surface with slight crust, about 2-3 cm pieces, clustered at the lower left center of the plate | 30
ITEM 5 | Creamy white sauce or dressing, opaque and thick, smeared over the upper left and center of the plate and partly coating the cubed pieces, slight sheen, about 5 cm by 4 cm footprint, under 1 cm thick | 25
ITEM 6 | Small dark mushroom-like pieces, grey-brown with slightly glossy caps, scattered at the upper left edge of the plate, each about 1-2 cm across | 10
ITEM 7 | Small toasted bread or crouton-like pieces, golden brown with crisp edges, a couple of cubes about 1.5 cm each, near the top center beside the greens | 8
